title: Virtual Ion-Optics Testbed (VIOT)
description: A multiscale assessment of carbon-nanomaterial accelerator-grid coatings for charge-exchange erosion mitigation in the NASA NSTAR ion thruster — GPU PIC-MCC plasma simulation, LAMMPS AIREBO molecular dynamics, and custom 3D Poisson/DSMC solvers.

title: Time-Series Modeling of Pulsed-Mode N₂O RCS Thrusters
description: A five-phase computational study for ICAETM 2026: a lumped-parameter physics model of catalytic N₂O decomposition, statistical characterization of the resulting pulse-train time series, and an LSTM predictive model benchmarked against an ARIMA baseline.

title: Tensor Basis Neural Networks vs. Random Forests for RANS Turbulence Closure
description: A methods study for ICMAI-MAC 2026 (NIT Goa) comparing Tensor Basis Neural Networks and Tensor Basis Random Forests as machine-learned Reynolds-stress anisotropy closures on the NASA wall-mounted hump benchmark, with spatially-resolved SHAP analysis.

title: Smart Ambulance Device-Interoperability Gateway
description: A working connected-ambulance prototype: auto-detects BLE medical-device protocols, prioritizes vital-sign data under bandwidth loss, stores-and-forwards offline, and normalizes telemetry into FHIR-style JSON for a hospital triage dashboard.

title: Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Lunar Imagery Toolkit
description: A Smart India Hackathon entry (SIH26166) building image co-registration, calibration, and matching tools for Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter High Resolution Camera (OHRC) lunar surface imagery from ISRO's PRADAN archive.

title: AeroSpace Multiphysics Pipeline
description: A GPU-accelerated multiphysics pipeline for NSTAR ion thruster plasma simulation — charge-exchange kinetics through WarpX PIC to Fowler–Nordheim field-emission risk assessment, comparing Molybdenum against GNP coatings.

title: qsim-studio
description: A from-scratch, GPU-accelerated quantum computing simulator and visualization platform — statevectors, gates, measurement, and a circuit IR with QASM-2 support, built without external quantum libraries.

title: Rocket Nozzle Throat Insert — Microstructure-Informed FEA
description: Thermo-structural finite element analysis of a solid rocket motor nozzle throat insert: material selection (C-103), defect sensitivity, and microstructure-informed failure assessment.

title: ProfNet
description: A local-first personal CRM for academics — tracks professors, communications, reminders, and collaborations entirely on-device, with no cloud and no API keys.

title: CFD Learning Series
description: A structured, beginner-to-intermediate CFD workflow in ANSYS Fluent — geometry through meshing, solving, and post-processing across three canonical cases of increasing complexity.

title: Sky Strike
description: A pixel-art retro plane shooter written as a single C file for native Windows — gamepad and keyboard input, zero game engine.

title: Manim Explainers
description: Animated math explainer videos built with Manim, covering linear differential equations for a computational methods coursework unit.
